name: Salience Bias
definition: Conspicuous information dominates attention or judgment beyond its relevance.
boundary: Salience concerns prominence; attentional bias is broader and can arise from internal concerns.

source_variants.name: Salience Bias (Belirginlik yanlılığı)
source_variants.definition: Focusing on conspicuous information and ignoring less visible but important data.
source_variants.coverage_reason: No named mechanism, required state or observation model is implemented in the original Mesa sample.
